name: Barbell bench press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with eyes under the bar.
Grip slightly wider than shoulder width.
Unrack and lower to mid-chest with elbows ~45 degrees.
Press up until elbows are locked.

name: Push-up
instructions: Plank position with hands under shoulders.
Keep body in a straight line.
Lower chest to within an inch of the floor.
Press back to start.

name: Dumbbell bench press
instructions: Sit with dumbbells on thighs, kick back to a flat bench position.
Lower dumbbells to chest level.
Press up to lockout, then control back down.

name: Incline dumbbell press
instructions: Set bench to ~30 degrees.
Press dumbbells from shoulder level to overhead lockout.
Lower with control.

name: Pull-up
instructions: Hang from bar with overhand grip slightly wider than shoulders.
Pull chest toward bar by driving elbows down.
Lower under control to a full hang.

name: Barbell row
instructions: Hinge at hips, torso roughly 45 degrees.
Pull bar to lower chest, elbows close.
Lower with control.

name: Lat pulldown
instructions: Set knee pad and grip the bar wider than shoulders.
Pull bar to upper chest, drive elbows down.
Resist on the way up.

name: Seated cable row
instructions: Sit tall, knees soft.
Pull handle to lower abs, squeeze shoulder blades.
Return slowly without rounding back.

name: Back squat
instructions: Bar on upper traps, feet shoulder-width.
Brace and squat to parallel or below.
Drive through midfoot to stand.

name: Goblet squat
instructions: Hold dumbbell at chest.
Squat with chest tall, knees tracking toes.
Stand to lockout.

name: Bodyweight squat
instructions: Feet shoulder width, toes slightly out.
Squat to comfortable depth.
Stand tall.

name: Romanian deadlift
instructions: Hinge at hips with soft knees.
Lower bar along thighs to mid-shin.
Drive hips forward to stand.

name: Conventional deadlift
instructions: Bar over midfoot, hands just outside knees.
Brace, hinge, push the floor away.
Lockout with hips and knees aligned.

name: Walking lunge
instructions: Step forward into a lunge, knee tracks toe.
Push off front foot to stand.
Alternate legs.

name: Hip thrust
instructions: Upper back on bench, bar over hips.
Drive hips up to lockout.
Lower with control.

name: Standing overhead press
instructions: Bar at shoulders, elbows under wrists.
Brace and press overhead, head through at lockout.
Lower under control.

name: Dumbbell shoulder press
instructions: Sit upright, dumbbells at shoulders.
Press overhead.
Lower to start.

name: Lateral raise
instructions: Stand tall, slight forward lean.
Raise dumbbells to shoulder height with soft elbows.
Lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell biceps curl
instructions: Stand tall, elbows pinned to sides.
Curl to shoulder, supinate grip.
Lower with control.

name: Cable triceps pushdown
instructions: Elbows pinned, push handle down to lockout.
Return to chest level under control.

name: Plank hold
instructions: Forearms under shoulders.
Body straight, glutes squeezed.
Breathe.

name: Hanging knee raise
instructions: Hang from a bar.
Curl knees toward chest.
Lower under control.

name: Standing calf raise
instructions: Stand on a step or floor.
Press up onto balls of feet.
Lower under stretch.

name: Easy run
instructions: Conversational pace.
Land midfoot.
Relax shoulders.

name: Rowing machine
instructions: Drive with legs first.
Lean back slightly, pull handle to ribs.
Return: arms, body, legs.

name: Jump rope
instructions: Soft knees, light bounce.
Wrist rotation drives the rope, not arms.
